get.description: Field definitions by position: the built-in ones (priority, severity, layer, owner, epic, feature, story, suite, component) and the custom ones.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Include archived fields.

delete.description: Archives a field: values on cases are kept and it can be restored with `PATCH {archived: false}`.

patch.description: Changes a field; every key is optional. `type` may only be sent unchanged; `archived` archives or restores.

get.description: One level of the folder tree (`parent` absent = top level), by position and name, with the counts of the cases (not archived) in each folder and its subfolders. `all=true` answers the whole tree at once, parents before children (by depth, then position and name), at most `maxFolders` folders (`truncated` when there are more).

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: The folder whose children are listed; absent lists the top level.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: `true`: the whole tree in one answer (parents first, at most `maxFolders`); not with `parent`.

delete.description: Deletes a folder. One with subfolders or cases needs `mode`: `moveUp` moves them to the parent, `archiveCases` archives the cases of the whole subtree and deletes the subfolders.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Required when the folder has subfolders or cases.

patch.description: Renames, reorders or moves a folder with its subtree (`parentId: null` moves it to the top level).

post.description: Applies an AI suggestion as a version with `source = ai`. `If-Match` is the ETag of the case; a case that moved since the suggestion was made answers 409 `suggestion_stale`.

get.description: A page of cases (not archived unless `archived=true`) with the newest result over all identities.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: A folder id: its cases, with `recursive=true` also those of its subfolders.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words of the name, description, preconditions or steps, or a number (`TC-12`).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `draft`, `active` or `outdated`; repeated or comma-separated.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: `key:value` of a case field; repeated: the same key matches any value, different keys all.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: A tag; repeated: all of them.

parameters.name: staleDays
parameters.description: Automated cases without a trusted result for this many days.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: `true` lists the archived cases (the trash).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `number` (default), `-number` or `updated` (most recent first).

404.description: folder or attachment of another project

post.description: Starts creating cases for the existing tests seen on trusted branches (`caseSync`), or returns the backfill already queued or running. Runs once by itself after the upgrade.

One action on cases named by number or matched by a filter (at most `maxBulk`). `move` takes a folder id or null, `setStatus` a status, `setField` `{key, value}`, `addTags`/`removeTags` a list. Each changed case gets one version with `source = bulk`; the others are listed in `skipped` with a code.

get.description: Streams the (not archived) cases of a filter as CSV (cells that a spreadsheet would run as a formula start with `'`) or FastProof NDJSON, at most 50 000 cases (409 `limit_reached` above).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` or `ndjson` (the FastProof format the importer reads back).

post.description: Starts a zip export job. The answer's `downloadUrl` (shown only here) is a one-time link for the caller, valid for 24 hours once the job is `done`. A caller has at most 2 and a project at most 4 exports queued or running (else 409 `export_busy`).

get.description: Downloads a finished zip export once: only its creator, with the token of `downloadUrl`, within 24 hours.

404.description: unknown, not done, used, expired, another caller or a wrong token

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: `folder` (default), `behavior` (epic → feature → story) or `suite`.

parameters.name: parent

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: case number

put.description: Replaces the content of a case. Fields, tags, status and `folderId` absent from the body keep their values (`folderId: null` moves the case to the root). Values that code owns on an automated case cannot change (409 `field_from_code`).

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: "r<revision>"

delete.description: Moves a case to the trash (archive); `purge=true` deletes it with its versions (needs `settings:write`; cases executed in manual runs answer 409 `case_has_runs`).

parameters.name: purge
parameters.description: Deletes the case for good (`settings:write`).

patch.description: Merges folder, status, field values (`null` removes one) and tags into a case.

post.description: Stores an attachment of the case (raw body, content-addressed per project); reference it from a step's `attachments` or as `![alt](attachment:<id>)` in Markdown.

parameters.name: X-FastProof-Attachment-Name
parameters.description: file name

get.description: Results of the case over all its identities (manual and automated), newest first.

post.description: Links a code identity (a test as uploads name it) to the case, e.g. after a rename. When it was the last identity of another case, that case is archived with a link to this one.
Takes a case out of the trash.
Marks a case an AI agent created as reviewed: clears `aiUnreviewed` (no new version). Audited as `case.review`; a case that is already reviewed is returned unchanged.
Makes the content of a version current as a new version (`source = restore`); values code owns on an automated case stay.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day (`YYYY-MM-DD` or RFC 3339, UTC); default 30 days before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day (inclusive); default today.

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: `day` (default) or `week`.

200.description: text/event-stream: `launch.updated` {id}, `upload.updated` {launchId, id}; `ready` first, `resync` after missed events. The stream ends when the caller loses access (checked every few minutes)

post.description: Starts an import job, always as a dry run (`ready` with an `ImportReport`; apply it with `POST /imports/{id}/apply`). Either multipart with `file` (CSV, JSON or NDJSON, at most `maxImportBytes`), `options` (`ImportOptions` JSON) and optionally `attachments` (a zip whose files cases reference by name, at most `maxImportZipBytes`), or JSON `TestOpsImport` (beta: the token is stored as a project secret at once and never returned, logged or audited; the host must be allowed by `FASTPROOF_EGRESS_ALLOW`). One import per project at a time.
Reads the first 5 MB of a file (multipart field `file`) and answers the detected format, the header, the first 20 rows, the suggested column mapping and the steps layout. Nothing is stored.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The format; detected when absent.

get.description: Status, progress and report (the dry run's while `ready`, the applied one when `done`) of an import.

delete.description: Cancels an import that is not finished; applied batches stay.

post.description: Applies a ready import (its dry run): cases are created and, with `upsert`, matching ones updated with a version `source = import`.

parameters.name: attr

200.description: a launch with this externalId exists

post.description: Merges launches (CI shards, re-runs) into a new launch or into one of them (`into`). A test run in several of them becomes one result with more attempts (the latest is the result, mixed outcomes are flaky in the run); counters, transitions, flakiness, defects and the series statistics are recomputed (the analysis may finish shortly after the answer: `analysing`). The other launches are hidden (`mergedInto`) and refuse further writes with 409 `launch_merged`; they come back on undo, possible until `undoUntil` (`FASTPROOF_MERGE_UNDO_HOURS`), and are deleted afterwards (a merge with `final` keeps them a couple of minutes for writes on their way). Repeating the same merge returns it (200) and copies what reached the launches since. Launches to merge must be finished with no upload in progress (409 `launch_running`, `launch_busy`); the target may run, but a finished target takes the merge only from its creator or a caller with `cases:sync` (409 `launch_finished`). Also 409 `launch_merged`, `launch_manual`, `launch_plan`, `merge_mixed` (debug or branch differ), `launch_rolled_up`, `merge_busy` (another merge or undo of the project runs); 413 `merge_too_large` (attempts or log bytes). `dryRun` answers counts (status `preview`) without merging and without locks.

200.description: a preview, or the same merge made before

Reopens a closed manual run.

post.description: Renders Markdown as cases show it (at most 64 KiB; raw HTML becomes text).

Undoes a merge before `undoUntil`: a launch the merge created is deleted, or the copied attempts leave the launch merged into; the merged launches come back. 409 `merge_not_active`, `merge_final`, `merge_expired`, `merge_target_changed` (results or logs were added to a created launch: delete it instead), `merge_target_merged`, `merge_target_rolled_up`, `merge_target_gone`, `merge_source_gone`, `merge_busy`; 403 `merge_target_triaged` when people triaged the created launch and the caller lacks `results:triage`.

Sorted by name, at most 100. Assignees are free text; names that are not in this list are allowed.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only principals whose name contains this text (case-insensitive, at most 200 bytes).

get.description: A run item with the executed version of its case (Markdown and sanitized HTML), its step results and `ETag: "r<revision>"`.

patch.description: Changes the status, comment or assignee of a run item (needs `If-Match`). A final status (`passed`, `failed`, `blocked`, `skipped`) is projected into the launch results (`blocked` as `broken`); back to `untested` or `in_progress` removes the projected attempt. `untestedStepsTo: skipped` marks the untested steps skipped.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the item

post.description: Stores a file for a step result (raw body, at most `maxAttachmentBytes`; name in `X-FastProof-Attachment-Name`), content-addressed like launch attachments. Reference it in `attachmentIds` of a step write.

parameters.name: X-FastProof-Attachment-Name
parameters.description: file name

post.description: Triages the projected result of a run item (the same triage as `/triage`, `source: user`) and keeps the defect on the item. Holders of `results:triage` may set it on any item; holders of `runs:execute` only on items they executed (the executor of the current execution; the assignee does not count). Otherwise 403 with `details {required: "results:triage", scope}`.

get.description: Earlier executions of a run item (kept on rerun), newest first, with their step results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most 100 (default 50).

get.description: A link that opens a prefilled new issue in a configured tracker (`issueTrackers` settings) with the case, the failed step, expected and actual results and a link back to the run item. Nothing is sent to the tracker. Jira: with `projectId` and `issueTypeId` in the tracker settings the link opens a filled-in create form (`CreateIssueDetails!init.jspa`, which Jira 9+ may disable); without them it opens Jira's create page and `prefilled` is false. Jira answers always carry the text in `prefill` for copying.

parameters.name: tracker
parameters.description: `jira`, `gitlab` or `github` (default: the first configured issue tracker).

post.description: Starts a new execution of the item (`executionNo + 1`, `untested`, no step results; needs the item's `If-Match`). The previous execution (status, comment, executor, times, defect, step results with their attachments) is kept outside the result partitions and listed by `GET /run-items/{itemId}/executions`; its attempt stays in the result's attempts. Audited as `runItem.rerun`.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the item

put.description: Writes the result of one step (`path` = `1`, `1.2`, `1.2.3` over the executed version). No `If-Match`: the last writer wins, and writing the same value again is harmless. Absent `actual`, `comment` and `attachmentIds` keep their values. An untested item becomes `in_progress`. `suggestedStatus` is the item status the step results suggest.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to find (1..=256 bytes; a substring in PostgreSQL and ClickHouse, a phrase in OpenSearch).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: RFC 3339; default 7 days before `to`; at most 31 days before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: RFC 3339; default now.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Lowest level: `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`.

get.description: Names, purposes and origins of the project's secrets; values are write-only.

put.description: Creates or replaces a secret, encrypted at rest with `FASTPROOF_SECRETS_KEY_FILE` and bound to a purpose and, optionally, the origin it may be sent to. Settings refer to it by name (`secretRef`, `targetSecretRef`, `tokenSecretRef`); a reference with another purpose, or a URL on another origin, is refused.

get.description: The settings document. Callers without `settings:write` get notification targets and the `vcs` and `fastmock` URLs emptied, with `redacted: true` on each.

requestBody.description: The areas to change. Each top-level area present in the body (`flaky`, `retention`, `rollup`, `gates`, `notifications`, `issueTrackers`, `fastmock`, `vcs`) replaces the stored one as a whole; areas left out are kept; `null` resets an area to its default (removes it). `caseSync` is merged by key instead (and its `fields` by field): keys left out keep their values, a `null` key returns to its default. The answer is the whole stored document.

get.description: Allure `testplan.json`: the stored tests of an adhoc plan, or the live automated cases of a managed plan (409 `plan_has_no_automated_cases` when it has none: an empty file would run every test).
A test-management job of the project (import, export, backfill): status, progress and report. Export jobs are visible only to their creator, import jobs only with `cases:import`.
Managed tokens the caller may read (`tokens:read`). 404 when managed tokens are not configured.

parameters.description: Only tokens of this project (needs `tokens:read` there).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `active`, `expired` or `revoked`.

post.description: Creates a managed token (`tokens:write`). A token can grant only permissions its creator holds where it grants them; a token created by a managed token expires no later than its creator and is revoked with it.

get.description: Lifetimes, projects and roles the caller may grant (`tokens:write`).
The managed token of the request.

delete.description: Revokes a token (and the tokens it created). A token may always revoke itself.

get.description: The version of the server. Any signed-in principal may read it.

AttachmentRef.description: A stored attachment as a case or step result references it.

AttachmentView.description: An attachment as referenced by a result or step.

id.description: Attachment id; `null` when the file was not part of any upload.

clientId.description: Client id of an attempt sent through the results API: the `resultId` of its log lines.

Attribute.description: A key/value attribute of a launch.

AuditList.description: A page of audit records, newest first.

codeOwned.description: Field keys whose values come from code (policy `code` on an automated case).

folderId.description:
The folder id (`null` at the root); the same value a `PUT` keeps when it leaves
`folderId` out.

identities.description: The first 100 identities (manual first, then the newest seen).

identitiesTotal.description: How many identities the case has (`identities` may hold fewer).

CaseBody.description: Content of a case (`cases.body`, also the body of a version snapshot). Text is Markdown.

CaseBulk.description:
Body of `POST /cases/bulk`: `move` takes `folderId|null`, `setStatus` a status, `setField`
`{key, value}`, the tag actions a list of tags.

CaseBulkSkip.description: A case a bulk action skipped, with the reason (an error code).

attachments.description: Put the attachments of the cases into the zip.

sourceLabel.description: Allure label whose value code sync writes into this field.

CaseFieldPatch.description:
Body of `PATCH /case-fields/{id}`: every key optional; `type` may be sent only unchanged;
`archived` archives or restores the field.

CaseFilter.description: Structured case filter (case list, bulk, plans).

CaseFolderList.description: `{items}` of folders of one level, or of the whole tree with `all=true`.

truncated.description: With `all=true`: the project has more folders than `maxFolders` and the list stops there.

CaseFolderPatch.description: Body of `PATCH /case-folders/{id}`: rename, reorder, or move (`parentId`, `null` = root).

CaseFolderPathEntry.description: One folder on the path of a case.

CaseFolderRef.description: The folder of a case with its path from the root (the folder itself last).

CaseHistoryEntry.description: A result of a case (any identity) in its history.

CaseHistoryList.description: A page of the history of a case.

CaseHtml.description: The Markdown fields of a case body rendered to sanitized HTML.

CaseIdentity.description: A test identity (row of `test_cases`) linked to a case.

CaseKey.description: An external key of a case (`case_keys`).

CaseKeyKind.description: Kind of an external case key.

CasePatch.description: Body of `PATCH /cases/{n}` (merge): absent keys are kept, `folderId: null` moves to the root.

CaseProposal.description: What an AI suggestion proposes: a patch plus optionally a new name and body.

CaseSnapshot.description: The content of a case at one version (stored zstd-compressed in `case_versions.snapshot_z`).

CaseStep.description: One step of a case; steps nest up to `max_step_depth` levels. Text fields are Markdown.

attachments.description: Ids of attachments of the case.

id.description: Stable id across versions (`s_<ulid>`); an empty id on write is assigned by the server.

CaseStepHtml.description: A step rendered to sanitized HTML.

CaseSuggestion.description: An AI suggestion for a case, never applied without a person accepting it.

CaseSuggestionAccepted.description: A decided suggestion and the case.

CaseSyncFields.description: Field policy of code sync, per field.

CaseSyncSettings.description: How cases follow the tests in code (`caseSync`).

branches.description: Trusted branches: globs where `*` matches within a segment and `**` across `/`.

createCases.description: Create cases for new identities of trusted launches.

matchTmsLinks.description: Match identities to cases by TMS links (`tms` labels) of TestRail or Qase keys.

rootFolder.description: Folder under which created cases are placed.

staleAfterDays.description: Days without a trusted result after which a case counts as stale.

useCiDefaultBranch.description: Also trust the CI default branch (`vcs.defaultBranch`).

CaseTree.description: One level of the case tree.

CaseTreeNode.description:
A node of `GET /cases/tree`; for `groupBy=behavior|suite` the id is the value path joined
by U+001F.

CaseVersionSummary.description: A version of a case in its history.

folderId.description:
The folder: `null` is the root. Absent is the root on `POST` and keeps the folder on
`PUT`.

Cluster.description: A unique error of a launch.

knownSince.description: First seen in an earlier launch on this day.

ClusterStatuses.description: Failed and broken counts of a cluster.

Comparison.description: Launch B compared with launch A.

fixed.description: Failed or broken in A, passed in B (results of B).

newFailures.description: Failed or broken in B, passed or skipped in A (results of B).

stillFailing.description: Failed or broken in both (results of B).

truncated.description: A list was cut at its limit.

Counts.description: Status counts of a launch (results, not attempts).

CreatedTestPlan.description: What `POST /test-plans` answers: the managed plan, or the id and test count of an adhoc one.

CreatedToken.description: Answer of `POST /api/v1/tokens`: the token metadata and its value, shown only here.

DailyEntry.description: Daily aggregates of a test case (launches that were rolled up).

Defect.description: Triage of a result: defect type (with its group and name when triaged), comment, issue.

source.description: `user`, `ai` or `rule` (a rule without `ruleId` is the project default for failures).

DeliveryView.description: A delivery as the API shows it (no target, no payload).

evaluated.description: Results the rule was evaluated on.

truncated.description: More matches than listed, or the evaluation budget ran out.

DurationChange.description: A test that became slower or faster.

deltaMs.description: Duration in B minus duration in A.

ratio.description: Duration in B over duration in A.

EnvironmentCounts.description: The results of one environment of a launch.

key.description: The environment key of the series; `null` for results without one.

ErrorBody.description: The uniform error body (`franshub_http::ErrorBody`), for the documentation.

ErrorView.description: Error details of an attempt or step.

FastMockSettings.description: The FastMock instance whose journal is correlated with results.

FieldOption.description: An option of a select or multiselect field.

FieldPolicy.description:
Who owns a case field on automated cases: `code` (sync overwrites it, the UI shows it
read-only) or `case` (code fills it only when it creates the case).

FieldValue.description:
Value of a case field: select and text are strings, multiselect a list of strings, number
a number, date an ISO `yyyy-mm-dd` string; `null` when unset.

score.description: Share of status changes over the detection window (0..1).

historyDepth.description: Past runs that are compared: `-1` disables detection, `0` uses all (up to 50).

includePassedTests.description: Also mark passed tests as flaky.

stabilizationPeriod.description: Identical outcomes in a row that reset earlier instability.

FolderCounts.description: Cases in a folder and its subfolders (not archived).

FolderDeleteMode.description: What deleting a non-empty folder does with its content.

FolderFrom.description: Where code sync puts the cases it creates.

branches.description: Branch globs (`*` matches any text); every branch when absent.

GateReport.description:
The gate result of a launch: `pending` while the launch runs or uploads are processed,
otherwise `failed` when a rule of an enabled gate that applies to the branch does not hold.

GateRule.description:
A rule: it holds when `metric op value`. With `baseline`, `newFailures` compares with the
newest finished launch of that branch and the other metrics become the difference to it.

GrantableRole.description: A role and where the caller may grant it.

Grants.description: Permissions of the caller: in project P they are `global ∪ allScopes ∪ scopes[P]`.

HistoryEntry.description: One result of a test case in a launch.

HistoryList.description: History of a test case, newest first.

daily.description:
Daily aggregates before the oldest item, when the raw history is shorter than `limit`
(launches beyond the raw window).

IdentityKind.description: A code identity (from uploads) or the manual identity of a case.

ImportCaseStatus.description: Status an import gives the cases it creates.

ImportMode.description: Whether an import only creates cases or also updates matching ones.

oneOf.description:
Status of imported cases (`draft` or `active`); absent: the status the source maps, else
`active`. A case whose required fields have no value is imported as `draft`.

ImportPreview.description: First rows of an import file and the suggested column mapping.

ImportReport.description: What an import does (dry run) or did.

createdFields.description:
Field definitions the import creates (dry run) or created for unknown columns
(`unknownFieldValues: create`).

unknownFields.description: Fields of the source the import leaves out (no such field in the project).

warnings.description:
Rows imported with a change, such as a case set to `draft` because required fields
have no value (`required_fields_missing`); the first 1000.

ImportRowError.description: One row error of an import.

IssueTracker.description: An issue tracker for links from issue keys.

issueTypeId.description: Jira only: the numeric id of the issue type of new issues (`issuetype`).

keyRegex.description: Keys this tracker owns, e.g. `[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+` (matched in full).

projectId.description: Jira only: the numeric id of the project new issues go to (`pid`).

Label.description: A key/value label (Allure labels, JUnit properties, CTRF tags, Playwright annotations).

LabelFacet.description: The values of one label in a launch.

LabelName.description: A label name of a launch.

LastLaunch.description: The newest launch of a project.

LastResult.description: The newest result of a case over all its identities.

Launch.description: A launch: one run of a test suite, made of any number of uploads.

oneOf.description: Progress of the manual run, when the launch has one.

mergedInto.description: The launch this one was merged into: it is hidden from lists and takes no more results.

testPlanId.description: The managed plan the launch was started from.

mergeRequest.description: Merge request IID (GitLab) or pull request number (GitHub) of the pipeline.

LaunchEnvironment.description: The named environment of a launch; `key` is part of every series identity.

LaunchFacets.description: Counts per value of the explorer filters, over the launch (in the environment asked for).

baselineLaunchId.description:
The launch compared with: the previous finished launch on the same branch and
environment (absent without one; then every failure is new).

defects.description: Defect type ids (`none`: results without a defect).

newFailures.description: Failed or broken, not muted results whose series did not fail in the baseline launch.

LaunchManual.description: Manual progress of a launch (present when the launch has a manual run).

finishedAt.description: When the last run item got a final status.

startedAt.description:
When the first run item was started (the manual part has its own times; the launch's
`durationMs` covers the automated results only).

analysing.description: The analysis and statistics of the target are still being updated.

createdTarget.description: The merge created the target (else it merged into one of the launches).

status.description:
`preview`, `active` (can be undone until `undoUntil`, unless `final`), `undone`,
`final` (the sources are deleted) or `deleted` (the target was deleted, and the sources
with it).

targetId.description: Absent in a preview of a merge into a new launch.

undoUntil.description: Until when the merge can be undone (absent for a merge without undo).

dryRun.description: Check and count without merging (status `preview`); takes no locks.

final.description: No undo: the sources are deleted after a short grace (needs `settings:write`).

into.description: Merge into this launch (one of `launchIds`) instead of a new launch.

launchIds.description: The launches to merge, 2 to 20, the target included when `into` is given.

name.description: Name of the new launch (default: the name of the earliest source).

externalId.description: Client key: starting a launch with an external id that exists returns that launch.

LaunchVcs.description: Version control metadata of a launch.

commitUrl.description: Link to the commit; computed for GitHub and GitLab repositories when not given.

defaultBranch.description:
The default branch of the repository as the CI reports it (trusted by code sync when
`caseSync.useCiDefaultBranch`).

Link.description: A link from a result (`type` is `link`, `issue`, `tms` or a writer-specific value).

LogEntry.description: A log line with its launch, as reads and searches return it.

LogGap.description: Data of a `gap` event of `GET .../logs/stream`: lines dropped because the client was slow.

LogHits.description: Matching log lines of a search.

partial.description: True when the scan stopped at its budget before the time range was covered.

duplicates.description: Lines already stored (direct mode; in Kafka mode the writer drops them).

LogLine.description: One log line as clients send it and as the API returns it.

resultId.description: Client id of the result (the `id` of its `ReportResult`).

seq.description: Sequence number within the attempt; a line sent again with the same number is a no-op.

step.description: Name of the step the line belongs to.

ts.description: Time, milliseconds since the Unix epoch (an RFC 3339 string is accepted too).

LogStreamBatch.description: Data of a `log` event of `GET .../logs/stream`: lines in order.

ManualReportItem.description: One run item of the manual report.

ManualReportStep.description: One step of the manual report.

ManualUntestedTo.description: What closing a manual run does with untested items.

MediaUrl.description: A media URL and when it stops working.

url.description: Path of the URL, relative to the server: `/api/v1/media/<token>`.

attempts.description: Attempts copied into the target (in a preview: attempts of the sources).

duplicates.description: Attempts the target had already (same client key, test and start), not copied again.

lateAttempts.description: Attempts that reached a source after the merge and were copied later.

rekeyed.description: Attempts whose client key another test of the target used, copied under a new key.

results.description: Results of the target created or recomputed.

sharedSeries.description: Tests run in more than one of the merged launches: their results got more attempts.

number.description: Absent once the launch is deleted.

Metric.description: A metric a gate rule checks.

fault.description: A fault FastMock injected (not recorded in the journal of FastMock 0.1).

matchedStub.description: Id of the stub that answered.

nearMiss.description: `true` when no stub matched (see FastMock's near misses for the closest ones).

MockInteractions.description: The requests correlated with an attempt.

confidence.description: 0 to 1: how likely the items belong to this attempt.

truncated.description: More journal entries than were read could belong to the window.

days.description: Mute for this many days (1..=365); without it the mute has no end.

MuteRequest.description: Mute part of a triage request.

until.description: End of the mute; without it the mute lasts until removed.

MyRunItem.description: A run item in "my queue", with its launch.

NewIssuePrefill.description: Title and description of a new issue.

oneOf.description: The issue text, for trackers whose link may not carry it (Jira).

prefilled.description:
Whether `url` itself carries the title and description. `false` for a Jira tracker
without `projectId` and `issueTypeId`: `url` opens Jira's create page and the text is in
`prefill` to copy.

NewRule.description: Body of `POST .../rules` (and the rule of a dry run).

oneOf.description: Managed plans: cases added (and kept in sync) by a filter.

fromLaunchId.description: Take the tests of this launch with `statuses`.

oneOf.description:
`managed` creates a managed plan (needs `plans:write`) from `name`, `description`,
`caseNumbers` and `filter`; absent or `adhoc` is the stage-1 plan above.

testCaseIds.description: Test cases added to the plan.

expiresInDays.description: Lifetime in days: 1 to 365. Every token expires; without this field it is 90 days.

name.description: `[A-Za-z0-9._@-]`, 1 to 128 characters, unique among active tokens.

role.description: A role: `viewer`, `uploader`, `editor`, `admin` or a custom one.

scopes.description: Project keys, or `["*"]` for every project including later ones.

secretRef.description:
Webhook: the HMAC signing key (purpose `webhook`); Telegram: the bot token (purpose
`telegram`).

target.description:
Webhook or Slack URL, Telegram chat id, or comma-separated email addresses. A URL that
is itself a credential (a Slack webhook URL) belongs in a secret (`targetSecretRef`).

targetSecretRef.description:
Webhook and Slack: a secret (purpose `webhook` or `slack`) holding the URL, instead of
`target`. Teams: the secret (purpose `teams`) holding the workflow URL; required, as
Teams takes no `target`.

NotificationFilter.description:
Which launches a notification is about. Every part that is given must match; within a
list of globs one match is enough, while every `attributes` entry must match.

attributes.description:
Launch attributes as `key=value`; the launch needs every one of them (`value` may be a
glob, `key=*` only asks for the key).

NotificationTestResult.description: The result of a test notification.

delivered.description: Whether the receiver accepted the message (`2xx`, or the SMTP relay took it).

error.description: Why it was not delivered; never contains the target URL.

responseStatus.description: The HTTP status (or SMTP code) of the answer, when there was one.

items.description: A delivery as the API shows it (no target, no payload).

next.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (`before=`), `null` on the last page.

items.description: A launch: one run of a test suite, made of any number of uploads.

oneOf.description: Progress of the manual run, when the launch has one.

mergedInto.description: The launch this one was merged into: it is hidden from lists and takes no more results.

testPlanId.description: The managed plan the launch was started from.

next.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (`before=`), `null` on the last page.

items.description: One log line as clients send it and as the API returns it.

resultId.description: Client id of the result (the `id` of its `ReportResult`).

seq.description: Sequence number within the attempt; a line sent again with the same number is a no-op.

step.description: Name of the step the line belongs to.

ts.description: Time, milliseconds since the Unix epoch (an RFC 3339 string is accepted too).

next.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (`before=`), `null` on the last page.

items.description: A run item in "my queue", with its launch.

next.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (`before=`), `null` on the last page.

items.description: One result per series per launch.

caseNumber.description: Number of the case the result's identity is linked to.

clientIds.description:
Client ids of the attempts sent through the results API (the `id` reporters send, also
the `resultId` of their log lines), in result lists of a launch.

flaky.description: Flaky across runs (Allure 3 algorithm, project settings).

message.description: Error message of the final attempt (first 500 characters).

muteUntil.description: End of the mute, when it has one.

runItemId.description: The run item a manual result is projected from.

source.description:
`manual` for results projected from a manual run (always sent; optional in the schema
so that older clients and fixtures stay valid).

transition.description:
Status change against the previous run of the series on the same branch: `new`,
`fixed`, `regressed` or `malfunctioned`.

next.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (`before=`), `null` on the last page.

items.description: An earlier execution of a run item, kept when the item is rerun.

rerunBy.description: Who started the next execution, and when.

next.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (`before=`), `null` on the last page.
Opaque cursor for the next page (`before=`), `null` on the last page.
Opaque cursor for the next page (`before=`), `null` on the last page.
Opaque cursor for the next page (`before=`), `null` on the last page.

items.description: A result as a leaf of the launch tree.

name.description: The name shown in the tree (the test title, without the groups above it).

next.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (`before=`), `null` on the last page.

Parameter.description:
A test or step parameter.

`value` is `None` when the writer omitted it, and also after redaction of masked and
hidden parameters (see [`Parameter::redact`]); identity hashes are computed before
redaction, so they still cover secret values.

ParameterMode.description: How a parameter value may be shown.

ParameterView.description: A displayable parameter (masked and hidden ones are never returned).

passRate.description: passed / (total − skipped); `null` when nothing but skipped results ran.

Person.description: A principal someone can assign run items to.

principal.description: The principal name (`assignee` values compare with it).

PlanAssign.description: Who the items of a launch started from a plan are assigned to.

PlanLaunch.description: A launch started from a plan, with the CI hand-off.

PlanLaunchAttribute.description: A launch attribute given when starting a launch from a plan.

PlanSyncDiff.description: What syncing a filter plan adds and removes.

issueTrackers.description:
Issue trackers `{type: jira|gitlab|github, urlTemplate, keyRegex}`; triage builds issue
URLs from them when only a key is given.

Rejected.description: A result that was not accepted.

index.description: Position in the array or line number (zero-based) in NDJSON.

ReportAttachment.description: A reference to an attachment uploaded with `POST .../attachments`.

contentType.description: Content type to show; defaults to the one given at upload.

id.description: Attachment id returned by the server.

name.description: Name to show; defaults to the name given at upload.

ReportError.description: Error details of a result or step.

ReportResult.description: One attempt of one test, the unit of `POST /api/v1/projects/{key}/launches/{id}/results`.

fullName.description:
Stable full name (for example `com.example.CheckoutTest#pays`); identity is computed
from it unless `testCaseId` is given. Defaults to `name`.

id.description: Client id of this attempt, unique within the launch: sending it again is a no-op.

parameters.description: Parameters; `mode` `masked` or `hidden` values count for identity but are never shown.

start.description: Start, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

status.description: A final status, or `running` while the test runs.

stop.description: Stop, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

testCaseId.description: Explicit stable test case id (takes precedence over the full name).

traceparent.description: W3C `traceparent` of the test, for correlation with traces.

ReportStatus.description:
Status of a reported result: a final status, or `running` for a result opened before its
test finished (sent again later with the same `id` and a final status).

ReportStep.description: A step; nested steps form a tree.

start.description: Start, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

stop.description: Stop, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

muteReason.description: Why the series is muted, when it is.

ResultDetail.description: A result with its attempts, steps and history.

ResultSource.description: Whether a result comes from a manual run or from an upload; also the automation filter.

ResultSummary.description: One result per series per launch.

caseNumber.description: Number of the case the result's identity is linked to.

clientIds.description:
Client ids of the attempts sent through the results API (the `id` reporters send, also
the `resultId` of their log lines), in result lists of a launch.

flaky.description: Flaky across runs (Allure 3 algorithm, project settings).

message.description: Error message of the final attempt (first 500 characters).

muteUntil.description: End of the mute, when it has one.

runItemId.description: The run item a manual result is projected from.

source.description:
`manual` for results projected from a manual run (always sent; optional in the schema
so that older clients and fixtures stay valid).

transition.description:
Status change against the previous run of the series on the same branch: `new`,
`fixed`, `regressed` or `malfunctioned`.

RetentionPreview.description: Launches a retention run would delete.

importantKept.description: Important launches kept although beyond the window.

launchIds.description: The first launches that would go (oldest first, at most 50).

RetentionSettings.description: How long raw results are kept.

launchesKeep.description: Keep at most this many launches (important ones are not counted).

manualDays.description:
Launches with a manual run older than this many days are deleted; `0` keeps them
forever (they are evidence for quality audits).

rawDays.description: Launches older than this many days are deleted (after their history is rolled up).

RollupSettings.description: When launches are aggregated into daily history.

accept.description: Mark the failure as accepted (a known, tolerated failure).

RuleMatch.description: Conditions of a rule; all given ones must hold.

actual.description:
The measured value (a difference to the baseline for metrics other than
`newFailures` when the rule has a baseline); `null` when it cannot be measured.

RunDefectIssue.description: An issue linked to a run item.

RunItem.description: A run item with the executed version of its case.

RunItemExecution.description: An earlier execution of a run item, kept when the item is rerun.

rerunBy.description: Who started the next execution, and when.

RunItemSkip.description: A case left out when adding run items.

RunItemSkipCode.description:
Why a case was not added to a launch as a run item: `automated` (CI runs it; only manual
cases become run items) or `in_launch` (it has a run item already).

skipped.description: Cases left out: already in the launch or automated.

skips.description: Why named cases were left out (the first 1000).

RunStepResult.description:
The result of one step of a run item; `path` is `1`, `1.2`, `1.2.3` over the executed
version.

ScheduledJob.description: A periodic job of the scheduler.

SecretMeta.description: A secret as listed: the name only, never the value.

origin.description: The only origin (`https://host[:port]`) the secret may be sent to, when bound to one.

purpose.description:
What the secret may be used for: `vcs`, `fastmock`, `slack`, `telegram`, `webhook` or
`smtp` (absent for a secret stored before purposes existed; it must be stored again).

SecretPurpose.description: What a secret may be used for.

origin.description:
The only origin (`https://host[:port]`) the secret may be sent to. Required for `vcs`
(the GitLab base URL or GitHub API URL) and `fastmock` (the admin URL); taken from the
URL for `teams` (the value is the workflow URL, which must be `https`); optional for the
others (for `slack` and a webhook URL it must then be the origin of the URL itself).
Changing the URL in the settings needs the secret written again for the new origin.

purpose.description: What the secret is for; it is refused for anything else.

value.description: At most 8 KiB. Never returned by the API.

SeriesPoint.description: One past result of the same series.

score.description: 1 for the same fingerprint, else the text similarity of the messages (0..1).

Status.description: Final outcome of a test result, attempt or step.

StepStatus.description: Status of one step of a run item.

StepsLayout.description: How steps are laid out in a CSV import.

TestCaseView.description: A test case (logical identity across parameters and environments).

TestIdentity.description: A test identity, linked or not.

TestOpsImport.description:
An import from the Allure TestOps API. The token is stored as a project secret at once and
never returned, logged or audited.

TestPlanAssign.description: A new assignee of a plan case.

mutedTests.description: Muted tests of a managed plan (read by allure-js; also listed in `tests`).

TestPlanKind.description: Kind of a test plan: `adhoc` (stage 1, expires) or `managed`.

TestPlanPatch.description:
Body of `PATCH /test-plans/{id}` (with `If-Match`): every field optional, `filter: null`
removes the filter (the items it added stay until the next sync).

TestPlanTest.description: One test of an Allure test plan.

id.description: `ALLURE_ID` of the test, when it has one.

selector.description: Full name as the Allure adapter reports it.

TestPlanWrite.description: Body of creating or replacing a managed plan.

TmJobKind.description: Kind of a background test-management job.

TmJobStatus.description: Status of a background test-management job.

Token.description: A managed token; the value is never shown after creation.

lastUsedAt.description: Recorded at most once a minute.

parentId.description: The managed token that created this one: it expires no later and is revoked with it.

scopes.description: Project keys; `["*"]` for every project; empty for a global token.

TreeDefect.description: The parts of a defect that name and color it in the tree.

TreeNode.description: A node of the launch tree.

durationMs.description: Sum of the durations of the results under the node.

levels.description:
On the root of a label grouping: the label names of the levels, without those no
result has (pass them as `groupBy` to `.../tree/tests`).

testCount.description: Results directly in this node (not in its children), with `includeTests`.

tests.description:
The results directly in this node, with `includeTests`, when they fit the response;
absent while `testCount` is above zero, they are read page by page from `.../tree/tests`.

TreeTest.description: A result as a leaf of the launch tree.

name.description: The name shown in the tree (the test title, without the groups above it).

TriageIssue.description: Issue of a triage: a URL, or a key that a project issue tracker turns into one.

fingerprint.description: With `launchId`: every result of the launch with this fingerprint.

UnknownFieldValues.description: What an import does with select values that are not options yet.

UntestedStepsTo.description: What `untestedStepsTo` sets the untested steps of an item to.

format.description:
Requested format (`auto`, `allure`, `junit`, `ctrf`, `playwright`), replaced by the
detected one once processed.

UploadCounts.description: Uploads of a launch that are not done.

ValueCount.description: A value and how many results have it.

VcsSettings.description: Merge request comments and commit statuses.

repository.description:
The only repository the token is used for: `group/sub/app` on GitLab, `owner/repo` on
GitHub. A launch whose repository is another one gets no comment or status.

sourceBranches.description: Branch globs: only launches of these branches (the merge request source branch) post.

tokenSecretRef.description: A secret with purpose `vcs` bound to the origin of `url`.

url.description:
GitLab base URL (`https://gitlab.example.com`) or GitHub API URL
(`https://api.github.com`, `https://github.example.com/api/v3`).

version.description: The release tag without the `v` (such as `0.2.0`), or the Cargo version of a local build.

tags.name: cases
tags.description: Test cases, folders, fields, versions and AI suggestions

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Manual runs: run items and step results

tags.description: Imports and exports of test cases
